build.command: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro -v /tmp/wa-out:/out rust:1.92.0-bookworm bash -c 'set -e; export PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH; rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown; cp -r /src /build; cd /build; cargo build --release --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wat_assembler.wasm /out/'

dependencies.name: wat
dependencies.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

dependencies.name: wast
dependencies.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

dependencies.name: wasm-encoder
dependencies.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

equivalence.reference: wat2wasm (wabt 1.0.39), the compiler that produced the committed artifact
equivalence.note: The wat crate emits a name custom section that wat2wasm omits; the assembler strips exactly that section, after which the encodings agree byte for byte.
